input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, guaranteed spend, take-or-pay obligation or volume floor binding the Company. The sole fee obligation (Section 3.1) is a pure revenue share of 30% of actual Net Sales, and only on Net Sales above an $11,000 per month threshold — i.e., fees are payable solely by reference to actual usage/sales, which is the preferred position. There is no shortfall or make-whole mechanic, and the term is a rolling one-year term terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice (Section 4.1), so no multi-year lock-in exists. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "guarantee" and volume-cap language returned nothing. Noted but not flagged here: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment is an exit-fee construct rather than a purchase commitment, is floored at zero, and is properly assessed under the termination/exit-fee rule rather than duplicated under this rule. The exclusivity covenant in Section 6.1 is a channel restriction, not a volume cap on the Company's usage, and belongs to the exclusivity rule.
